description: Position, scale, rotate, fade, flip, crop or fit a video clip over the tracks below (picture-in-picture, overlays, punch-ins). fit none shows a graphic at its own pixel size, so scale 1 is its real size; the default contain scales it to touch the frame edges. Any number takes a constant or {keyframes: [{frame, value, ease}]} with frames from the clip start; eases are listed at video://catalog/eases. Omitted fields keep their value; null resets one. To pin an overlay to a moving subject, use media.analyze track boxes as keyframes: for each box, frame = timeline frame of the box time (where the tracked clip plays that media second) minus this clip's start, x = box x + w/2 and y = box y + h/2 (add your offset). That holds when the tracked clip fills the frame as is; if it is scaled, moved or cropped, map the box through its transform first. Skip boxes with found false. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

keyframes.description: frame is relative to the clip start; ease from video://catalog/eases

anyOf.description: Fractions of the picture hidden from each edge; the rest stays where it was

contain: whole picture inside the frame, scaled up or down to touch its edges (default); cover: fill the frame, cropping; fill: stretch; none: its own pixels at sequence size, unscaled (a 300 px logo stays 300 px on a 1920 px sequence), for logos and graphics made to size

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

scale.description: Size relative to the fit (default 1); 0 to 20

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

x.description: Centre x, 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge (default 0.5); -4 to 5
